description: The pinyin index letter of a character, on all four kits. The letters come from the platform pinyin collation the Vue kit reads at runtime and the generated table (tooling/build-pinyin-initials.mjs) encodes for Flutter and Compose; SwiftUI reads its own transliteration. A kit that disagrees here has a defect, not a dialect (FR-044).
